findings.evidence: New lines 59-62 require only `ContinuousOn γ (Icc a b)` and differentiability on `Ioo a b`; existing contour APIs use oriented intervals, e.g. `ArcFTC.lean:58-60` has continuity on `Set.uIcc a b` and differentiability on `Set.Ioo (min a b) (max a b)`, and `WindingNumber.lean:88-90` also uses `Set.uIcc a b` for `∫ t in a..b`.
findings.fix: Define the predicate over `Set.uIcc a b` and `Set.Ioo (min a b) (max a b)` for breakpoints/differentiability, or add and propagate an explicit `a ≤ b` hypothesis everywhere this regularity is consumed.
findings.issue: `IsPiecewiseC1On` uses `Icc a b` and `Ioo a b`, so if `b < a` both regularity regions are empty and every raw function is piecewise `C¹` on `a..b`.

summary: The new predicate is not faithful to the oriented interval contour API: for reversed endpoints it becomes vacuous while downstream contour integrals still run over the nonempty interval.
